overview.severity_time_explanation: In parkinsons_updrs.data, test_time measures days relative to each participant's formal trial recruitment baseline (Day 0). Exactly 12 records across 2 participants (Subject 34 at -3.31d and Subject 42 at -4.26d) were captured 3 to 4 days prior to their formal baseline recruitment date. Post-recruitment measurements span 0.0 to 215.49 days, and individual participant follow-up spans 153.0 to 204.0 elapsed days.

features_schema.name: MDVP:Fo(Hz)
features_schema.label: Average Fundamental Frequency (Fo)
features_schema.description: Average vocal fundamental frequency across the sustained vowel phonation.

features_schema.name: MDVP:Fhi(Hz)
features_schema.label: Maximum Fundamental Frequency (Fhi)
features_schema.description: Maximum vocal fundamental frequency recorded during phonation.

features_schema.name: MDVP:Flo(Hz)
features_schema.label: Minimum Fundamental Frequency (Flo)
features_schema.description: Minimum vocal fundamental frequency recorded during phonation.

features_schema.name: MDVP:Jitter(%)
features_schema.label: MDVP Jitter (%)
features_schema.description: Cycle-to-cycle variation in fundamental frequency expressed as a percentage.

features_schema.name: MDVP:Jitter(Abs)
features_schema.label: MDVP Absolute Jitter
features_schema.description: Absolute cycle-to-cycle period perturbation in seconds.

features_schema.name: MDVP:RAP
features_schema.label: Relative Average Perturbation (RAP)
features_schema.description: Relative average perturbation smoothed over 3-period windows.

features_schema.name: MDVP:PPQ
features_schema.label: Five-Point Period Perturbation Quotient (PPQ)
features_schema.description: Period perturbation quotient smoothed over 5-period windows.

features_schema.name: Jitter:DDP
features_schema.label: Difference of Differences of Periods (DDP)
features_schema.description: Average absolute difference between consecutive differences between pitch periods (3 × RAP).

features_schema.name: MDVP:Shimmer
features_schema.label: MDVP Local Shimmer
features_schema.description: Cycle-to-cycle variation in vocal peak-to-peak amplitude.

features_schema.name: MDVP:Shimmer(dB)
features_schema.label: MDVP Shimmer (dB)
features_schema.description: Cycle-to-cycle peak amplitude variation measured in decibels.

features_schema.name: Shimmer:APQ3
features_schema.label: Three-Point Amplitude Perturbation Quotient (APQ3)
features_schema.description: Three-point amplitude perturbation quotient across glottal cycles.

features_schema.name: Shimmer:APQ5
features_schema.label: Five-Point Amplitude Perturbation Quotient (APQ5)
features_schema.description: Five-point amplitude perturbation quotient across glottal cycles.

features_schema.name: MDVP:APQ
features_schema.label: MDVP 11-Point Amplitude Perturbation Quotient (APQ)
features_schema.description: 11-point amplitude perturbation quotient capturing broader amplitude instability.

features_schema.name: Shimmer:DDA
features_schema.label: Average Absolute Differences of Amplitude (DDA)
features_schema.description: Average absolute difference between consecutive differences of cycle amplitudes (3 × APQ3).

features_schema.name: NHR
features_schema.label: Noise-to-Harmonics Ratio (NHR)
features_schema.description: Ratio of inharmonic noise energy to harmonic tonal energy in the voice signal.

features_schema.name: HNR
features_schema.label: Harmonics-to-Noise Ratio (HNR)
features_schema.description: Ratio of harmonic periodic energy to acoustic noise in decibels (higher indicates clearer phonation).

features_schema.name: RPDE
features_schema.label: Recurrence Period Density Entropy (RPDE)
features_schema.description: Uncertainty in glottal pitch period periodicity measured via phase-space recurrence.

features_schema.name: DFA
features_schema.label: Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (DFA)
features_schema.description: Signal fractal scaling exponent characterizing turbulent airflow self-similarity.

features_schema.name: spread1
features_schema.label: Nonlinear Pitch Frequency Variation (spread1)
features_schema.description: First nonlinear measure of fundamental frequency variation.

features_schema.name: spread2
features_schema.label: Nonlinear Pitch Frequency Variation (spread2)
features_schema.description: Second nonlinear measure of fundamental frequency variation.

features_schema.name: D2
features_schema.label: Correlation Dimension (D2)
features_schema.description: Nonlinear dynamical complexity estimate representing degrees of freedom in vocal fold oscillation.

features_schema.name: PPE
features_schema.label: Pitch Period Entropy (PPE)
features_schema.description: Logarithmic entropy measure of impaired pitch control unaffected by smooth vibrato.

progression_summary.time_alignment_note: test_time is measured in days relative to each participant's formal baseline recruitment date (Day 0). 12 observations across Subjects 34 (-3.31d) and 42 (-4.26d) were recorded 3–4 days before formal baseline enrollment, which places them in the <0 day pre-baseline bin when grouped by recruitment date. Aligning by each participant's first observation (Elapsed Days ≥ 0) spans 0 to 204.0 days.
progression_summary.notice: Descriptive means in approximate 30-day study-time bins. Sampling density varies over time; this is not a forecast.
